id.description: Lowercase words joined by dots, such as acme.fancy-arrows. Never changes between versions. Ids starting with core. are kept for the plugins that come with the app.

name.description: What authors see in Help > Plugins.

apiVersion.description: The plugin API this plugin was written for. This version of ExperienceForge has API version 1.

type.description: One lowercase word, such as stage or export. Shown to the author; changes nothing.

capabilities.description: The sensitive things the plugin needs. The plugin API refuses a call that needs one that is not listed.

downloadUrl.description: Where to get this plugin: a plain https address. A course that uses the plugin remembers it, so a person who opens the course without the plugin is shown where to find it.

buildsOn.description: Ids of plugins this one needs. It is skipped unless they are installed.
